author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: ESP32 Bit Pirate has reached version 1.8, adding experimental software-defined radio (SDR) functionality using the ESP32-S3’s internal Wi-Fi radio. The update also introduces browser-based firmware extraction tools, improved protocol debugging, expanded board compatibility, and updated Zigbee capabilities for ESP32-C5 and ESP32-C6 devices. title: ESP32 Bit Pirate 1.8 Adds Experimental SDR and Browser-Based Firmware Analysis

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The XPC nano NC50N by Shuttle is an upcoming barebone mini PC based on Intel’s N150 processor. The system supports up to 16GB of DDR5 memory, dual M.2 NVMe SSDs, and 2.5GbE networking, targeting digital signage, point-of-sale terminals, office environments, and multimedia applications. title: Barebones Mini PC from Shuttle Houses Intel N150 and Supports Three Storage Drives
